The player must navigate near the lantern (placed on an oak fence post at spawn-relative [5, 1, 5] via /setblock ~5 ~1 ~5 minecraft:lantern[hanging=false]) and face toward it, confirming visual observation. max_distance=16 allows detection from a reasonable range (lantern is ~7 blocks from spawn diagonally), and facing_tolerance=60 ensures the player is actually looking at the lantern rather than facing away. This rule type was chosen over position_inside_box because the task is about observing/finding an object, not just reaching a location.

The player spawns on a grass platform facing the general direction of the shelter and must navigate to find and observe the lantern.
task_text: Find the lantern in the scene. Look around and navigate toward the stone brick shelter to locate the lantern.

The shelter has a 2-block-wide doorway on the front (south) face. A torch at (3, 1, 0) acts as a visual landmark/decoy. The grass platform spans from -10 to +10 in both X and Z. The lantern is approximately 7 blocks diagonal from spawn, easily reachable within 20 steps.
